target: observe.sh SubagentStop — when transcript_path is the PARENT session's transcript, usage/model stay null instead of reporting the whole session's tokens as one subagent's
cmd: mkdir -p .agentic; printf '%s' '{"observability":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; unset CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR AGENTIC_OBSERVE; printf '%s\n' '{"sessionId":"SESS-A","message":{"id":"m1","model":"parent-model","usage":{"input_tokens":900000,"output_tokens":2280000}}}' > parent.jsonl; printf '%s\n' '{"sessionId":"CHILD-B","message":{"id":"m9","model":"child-model","usage":{"input_tokens":700,"output_tokens":90}}}' > child.jsonl; printf '%s' "{\"hook_event_name\":\"SubagentStop\",\"session_id\":\"SESS-A\",\"agent_id\":\"p1\",\"agent_type\":\"loop-reviewer\",\"transcript_path\":\"$PWD/parent.jsonl\",\"cwd\":\"$PWD\"}" | "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh"; printf '%s' "{\"hook_event_name\":\"SubagentStop\",\"session_id\":\"SESS-A\",\"agent_id\":\"c1\",\"agent_type\":\"loop-reviewer\",\"transcript_path\":\"$PWD/child.jsonl\",\"cwd\":\"$PWD\"}" | "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh"; cat .agentic/observability/events-*.jsonl | jq -cs '{parent: (map(select(.agent_id=="p1"))|first), child: (map(select(.agent_id=="c1"))|first)}'

provenance.note: 136 agent_stop events in claude-deck all pointed at one 8473-line parent transcript; naive attribution produced 254M output tokens
